firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently watched a ninja movie starts as the active Ninja.
clarifications: The starter receives all five Skill Dice; the player to their right receives four House Dice.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 1 states the recent-ninja-movie criterion and initial Skill/House Dice distribution. Page 2 credits Greenbrier Games LLP and labels the rules version 1.0; dice and treasure tokens match inventory BGG 136587. SHA-256: b31f4c265924433a7ba0f8c41e46f79d3dcacd3a334d1647808ee56c749e7a6a. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook. Label edit 2026-09-25: removed file/print bookkeeping from the edition label; rule content unchanged.
uncertainty: No tie procedure is stated for players who last watched the same ninja movie.

fairUse.rationale: Small crop of the original game container identifies the exact Greenbrier product discussed in this starting-rule article. It is used for editorial reference with no more package imagery than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Noble Knight listing https://www.nobleknight.com/P/2147578823/Ninja-Dice identifies the Greenbrier base game as manufacturer part GBR0022 and shows this original black ninja-head pouch with its rules and dice. Greenbrier's creator-led original Kickstarter https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/greenbriergames/ninja-dice/ and its English v1 rules identify the original game. A 2014 convention report https://www.ucon-gaming.org/2014/07/greenbrier-games-ninja-dice/ documents the same ninja-head holder supplied by Greenbrier at its booth. The image is cropped from a retailer product photo, not publisher-hosted, and no permission is implied. The retailer dates its stocked base game 2015 while the first campaign and package debuted in 2013-14; no claim is made that the photographed insert is the v1 rules sheet.
